full_judgment: Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why action of the respondent No. 6 by land filing in the natural reservoir/water retention land as identified in (Annexure-B and B-1) situated at RS Plot Nos. 5010, 5013, 5016, 5017 and adjacent Plots City Survey Plots Nos. 3001, 4007, City Survey Khatian No. 4, Mouza-Mirpur, P., No. 12, Gabtoli, Mirpur for a project of respondent No. 6 (BADC) at the place of the above natural reservoir and why the inaction of the respondent Nos. 1-5 for failing to protect the environment which is detrimental to the natural resources, biodversity, , wetland and its surrounding livelihood should not be declared to have been done without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and as to why the illegal land filing by changing the nature and character of the জলাশয়/প্রাকৃতিক জলাধার resvisor violating the provision of প্রাকৃতিক জলাধার সংরক্ষণ আইন, ২০০০, the Environment Conversation Rules, 1997, Building Construction Act, 1952 and Local Government (City Corporation Act, 2009) should not be declared without lawful authority and as to why the respondent No. 6 should not be directed to stop land filing the said reservoir and take necessary actions to bring the land of 12 acres in its original nature and character of পরিবেশ সংরক্ষণ আইন, ১৯৯৫ reservoir and or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper.
